newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet fuel demand flat, premiums unchanged.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet fuel demand flat, premiums unchanged.

text.p: NWE jet fuel demand was flat and premiums were notionally unchanged on Wednesday, traders said.
Benchmark Dec and Jan IPE futures plunged $10 each to $203 and $204.75 a tonne respectively following bearish API data and confirmation that Iraqi crude was flowing in earnest.

Barge premiums were about Jan IPE +$23/24 fob ARA for second half December. Cargo premiums were notionally Jan IPE +$25 fob NWE. Inquiries were few and far between after material sold into Copenhagen and Oslo early in the day. Many of the market's traders were absent from their desks at an industry function.
